metadata_only_policy: Resolve DOI via doi.org and DataONE CN metadata/index only. Do not retrieve process data entity bytes in this gate. This package is non-response process input but still frozen before use.
process_boundary: Spore dispersal information may be used as a pre-response process/connectivity predictor and process-support world only if the metadata/data object maps deterministically to the same 469 southern patch IDs. It is not an outcome and must not be tuned using canopy reappearance rows.
next_if_schema_resolves: freeze exact process data object identity, checksum, schema, period mapping and deterministic process-feature construction before retrieving process rows
stop_if_schema_ambiguous: do not open process data merely to infer ambiguous roles; keep only geometric structural worlds if the process package cannot be frozen
